name: ransomleak-secure-coding-action
description: Turns SARIF findings on a pull request into free secure-coding lesson links.

scripts.test: node --test src/sarif.test.ts src/pr-comment-state.test.ts src/lessons.test.ts src/pull-request.test.ts src/sonar-findings.test.ts src/sonar-client.test.ts
scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --define:__API_ORIGIN__='"https://app.ransomleak.com"' --outfile=dist/index.js
scripts.build:staging: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --define:__API_ORIGIN__=\"$API_ORIGIN\" --outfile=build-staging/index.js
